fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responders confirm the correct property from the road.
• Trim vegetation along both sides of the access drive so emergency vehicles can pass through without obstruction.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles, equipment, and stored materials so responding units can reach all structures without delay.
• Cut back dense vegetation near the detached structures so responders can move around them and locate entry points quickly.
• Mark or number each structure visibly from the access drive so responders can distinguish between them on arrival.
• Clear a path between the main residence and each detached structure so responders can move on foot between buildings without pushing through overgrown areas.
• Trim shrubs or tree branches along the access drive that block sightlines so approaching vehicles can see the full length of the drive before committing to it.
• Identify and mark a turnaround or staging area near the structures so emergency vehicles are not forced to back out along the single access point.
• Keep a gate, if present at the access point, unlocked or equipped with a Knox Box so responders are not delayed waiting for entry.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim shrubs and low branches that are directly touching or within a few feet of the structure.
• Thin the tree cluster nearest to the structure to create open space between individual trees and the building.
• Cut tall grass areas down before dry season, particularly any patches close to the structure or driveway.
• Remove woody debris piles from around the structure and any nearby outbuildings.
• Clear scattered shrubs growing along the driveway edges to keep the travel lane open for vehicles.
• Separate shrubs from the base of the structure by removing or pulling back vegetation growing against the walls or foundation.
• Thin scattered trees where their canopies touch or overlap near the structure to reduce how easily fire can move between them.
• Keep the single access route free of overhanging branches and encroaching shrubs along its full length.
• Remove dead or dry plant material from mixed vegetation areas closest to the structure.
• Mow or cut grass in open areas near the structure regularly during dry months to keep it short.
• Move any cut vegetation, brush piles, or yard waste away from the structure after clearing work is done.
• Keep the driveway entrance clearly marked and wide enough for emergency vehicles to enter without obstruction.
